I told Hollis in a thread on her #central-team message that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats.

That number comes from Tobias's post in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing posted since has changed it. Hollis is in that channel, so she could already see it. A seat count is an operational fact, so it's fine to share with the Central team. There are no shared Marrow files to check it against, and I said so in the reply.
